SELECT sum(a.money) total_recharge FROM ( SELECT p.member_id, p.money FROM member_recharge_online p WHERE p.status = 1
and p.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and p.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT m.member_id, m.recharge_money money FROM member_recharge_bank m WHERE m.status = 3
and m.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and m.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
UNION ALL SELECT u.member_id, u.recharge_money money FROM member_recharge_usdt u WHERE u.status = 3
and u.update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and u.update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
) as a inner join member_info as mi on mi.id = a.member_id
where mi.inviter_code = #{req.channelCode}

and update_time >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 00:00:00'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') and update_time <= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{req.inclusive_date},' 23:59:59'),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
and withdraw_id in (SELECT id from member_info where inviter_code = #{req.channelCode})
